scenario.summary: A hooded traveller demands entry to the keep after dark.

dialogue.speaker: traveller
dialogue.text: Open up! I must get inside.

dialogue.speaker: brannoc
dialogue.text: Halt, traveller. By the old oath, the gate stays shut past dusk.

dialogue.speaker: traveller
dialogue.text: I have urgent news for the lord.

dialogue.speaker: brannoc
dialogue.text: Then I must challenge you and protect the gate this night. Return at dawn and I shall offer shelter.
